requirement_text: When the change is a material security or privacy change, a qualified reviewer independent of the implementer must assess the change.
reviewer_notes: Extraction truncated 'When the change is a material security or privacy change' to 'When it is'. The intended condition is a materiality trigger: a change procedure covers material security changes, so omitting the review is a gap, not an exemption. Same pattern confirmed 108x in CONDROLE-REVIEW-V1; a third version of this requirement already extracts it as CONDITIONAL_OBLIGATION. Rule 11 (REQ-SCHEMA-V2) now rejects the fragment at extraction.
